name: EuroStocks Import
author: eurostocks

sections.description:
This plugin uses the EuroStocks Flow API for vehicle search over the EuroStocks import stock. Build your own storefront on it.

Discover the EuroStocks import software: your key to a virtual car showroom! This software effortlessly enables you to showcase over 300,000 German cars on your website, without making significant changes to your site.

Traditional car dealerships face challenges in a world where consumers know exactly what they want. EuroStocks offers a solution: easily import cars from Germany, expand your inventory, and remain competitive in a market where online shopping is the norm.

How does it work? EuroStocks retrieves real-time data from Mobile.de and adapts it to your local market. The selection only includes cars with known CO2 emissions, offered by recognized car dealerships, and is presented with all-in prices including any cost related to importing the vehicle.

The software seamlessly integrates with your website via our WordPress plugin, allowing you to offer customers a wider range of options and save costs without major changes to your site.

Why showcase German offerings? The number of imported cars is growing, while traditional car dealerships struggle with empty showrooms. With EuroStocks, you retain website traffic, and visitors benefit from an extensive selection of cars.

Curious? Leave your details for a free demo! EuroStocks also offers customization options, such as excluding certain brands or models, displaying vehicles from a specific year, and filters for specifications such as interior and lease terms.

Please note: This plugin requires a paid subscription to use.

External services

The plugin uses the EuroStocks Flow API for vehicle search, vehicle details, filters and catalog data. Requests occur when using the storefront, generating a PDF, looking up a vehicle for an enquiry or testing the connection in settings.

Service-account credentials are sent to auth.eurostocks.com for authentication. Access tokens, search terms, selected filters, sorting, pagination and vehicle IDs are sent to flow-api.eurostocks.com as needed.

Vehicle images load from API-provided URLs; image hosts receive the visitor’s IP address and browser request metadata. Enquiries are emailed through the site’s mail provider, not sent to Flow.

API documentation
Terms and conditions

Development source

Readable JavaScript and SCSS sources are included in assets/src/.

Customization

All three shortcodes accept a class attribute. Styling is restricted to .eurostocks-import, with CSS variables such as –esi-accent, –esi-radius and –esi-font. No Tailwind runtime or global reset is loaded.

The results page updates immediately after filter changes. Price mode, labels and available filters follow the API contract. Contact uses the configured email, telephone and WhatsApp details. Enable the optional vehicle contact form in Contact & aanvragen to send dealer enquiries and customer confirmations, including optional trade-in and API-enabled lease requests with the API monthly price. Without JavaScript, the email link remains available. The PDF download opens an A4 vehicle brochure with your logo, contact details, opening hours, photo, API prices, specifications and options. The PDF library is isolated from other plugins; an explicit PDF opt-out disables downloads.
sections.installation:
1. Activate the plugin and enter your EuroStocks service-account username and app password under EuroStocks.
  2. Create a results page with [eurostocks] and a vehicle page with [eurostocks_details]. Select both pages in the EuroStocks settings.
  3. Add [eurostocks_search] to your homepage or a shortcode widget. Choose fields with filters=”q,make,model,transmission,mileage,year,fuel”.
  4. Disable the old plugin when switching storefronts. While it is active, it keeps ownership of the shortcodes.
